goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city Testville, ZIP 99999, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. findings.problem: A sign-up popup in an iframe and a cookie banner covered the page on load; I had to find No Thanks and Reject All before anything else.

The size options appear as radios named XXS to XXL, but click and check on them all timed out, so I could not pick a size. Pressing ArrowRight did nothing. ADD TO BAG only showed the text Please Select Size, with no obvious error role or alert.
After the failed size selection the main menu links were missing from the tree and clicking the Accessories link timed out.

Dozens of buttons share the same name Quick Add Add, and many links and radios repeat identical names, so I had to guess an nth index. After Quick Add, size buttons named only XXS to XXL appeared with no product name; they were unlabelled by product.

After adding to bag, my click on Bag (1) Cart timed out although the Your Bag dialog opened by itself. The Checkout button click also looked like it did nothing: the page was unchanged until I re-read it.

The subtotal of $49.75 already included a $1.75 PackageProtect charge that I had not chosen. There was no clear way to remove it; only a button named Continue With PackageProtect and the Checkout button were offered.
